attributed_problem_convention.definition: For fixed k>3, f_k(n) maximizes the number of k-point lines in an n-point real-plane set with no line containing more than k points.

attributed_prior_count_identities.authors: Pentti Haukkanen and Jorma K. Merikoski
attributed_prior_count_identities.title: Some formulas for numbers of line segments and lines in a rectangular grid

mathematical_contract.domain: full finite integer rectangle; no irregular or higher-dimensional grid
mathematical_contract.unoriented_direction_convention: u>0 with either sign v, plus the vertical(0,1); positive/negative v share an absolute-direction profile
mathematical_contract.line_order: Increasing signed(u,v), then start_x, then start_y_reflected.
mathematical_contract.line_address: source_id,direction_id,start_x,start_y_reflected; source_id binds the declared index but is not authentication.
mathematical_contract.navigation: At least k points, k>=2; exact-k counts are separate and no exact-k rank/select is exposed.
mathematical_contract.point_ids: x_index*height+y_index, matching the accepted grid convention.
mathematical_contract.canonical_start: The predecessor is outside the rectangle: start_x<a or start_y_reflected<b.
mathematical_contract.count_identity: T_k=S_(k-1)-S_k, S_t=max(w-ta,0)*max(h-tb,0); t_k=T_k-T_(k+1). No additional factor1/2 for already unoriented directions.
